answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a per-identity bond locked and slashed for provable misconduct. New agents must post a non-transferable stake tied to a verified human root, and rewards vest only after the bond survives several settlement rounds. An attacker spinning up thousands of puppets must front that stake thousands of times, so swarm cost scales linearly while any fake ID is burned once it misbehaves. Honest agents raise a whisper flag on suspicious clusters, and each flagged ID loses its ivory record and the bond. Volume loses to verified participation under a basalt-firm slashing rule.
